notes: Status 'to_create' = not drawn yet. Status 'reusable' = exists in a Paper Prepper project (sourcePath verified 2026-11-06); copy it into the new project. Status 'engine_built' = built from Shape/KineticText via creative/animation-presets.json, no asset file.
Format: hand-authored SVG (asset-artist agent), palette hexes only, no SVG filters, no embedded raster, no text inside SVGs unless listed (text goes in KineticText so it can change per Short).
Baked shadow: a flat Ink #26303F copy at 20% opacity, offset down-right by tier (back 4px / mid 8px / front 12px at 1080w). No blur.
scripts/validate_project.py only accepts assets inside projects/<id>/. Copy each used file to projects/<id>/<suggestedPath> (same relative path).

Paper Prepper SVGs use the cocoa palette. They are allowed as-is in Ready Shorts (Ready tint matches). Optional recolor by hex find/replace: #3A2419 -> #26303F, #F4E6C8 -> #F5EEDD, #E9A93B -> #F2B632, #D2452B -> #E2553F, #5E8F86 -> #7FB3D5. Save recolors under a new filename; never edit the PP originals.

characters.description: Original paper-cutout snail, 1.6:1 wide. Kraft rounded foot/body, Paper belly edge, Sun Yellow shell (55% of height) with one Ink spiral line, two short eye stalks with Paper eye-whites and Ink dot pupils, small Ink mouth line, no arms. Faces right. 1024x1024 canvas, foot baseline at bottom centre, identical scale and shell position on every pose. Not like existing cartoon snails: no pink/purple shell, no lavender body, no long googly stalks, no stripes.

poseNotes.point: body leans forward 8 deg, both pupils to the right, mouth open 'o'
poseNotes.worry: stalks tilted out, pupils up, wavy mouth
poseNotes.idea: stalks straight up, 3 Sun Yellow spark dashes above, open smile
poseNotes.cheer: stalks up and out, closed happy eyes (arcs), big smile, foot tip lifted
poseNotes.shell_hide: body half retreated into the shell, only the stalk tips showing, pupils peeking
poseNotes.tired: stalks drooping forward, half-lidded eyes (Ink lid bar), flat mouth
poseNotes.skeptical: one stalk higher, one pupil narrowed, mouth sideways
poseNotes.carry: neutral face, flat-topped shell spot for a prop to sit on (prop is a separate element)
poseNotes.sleep: fully in shell, eyes closed arcs, 2 Sky 'z' cutouts
